rulesText: RULE diabetes_flag "Flag diabetes claims" WHEN 2300.HI.diagnosis_code = "E11.9" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Diabetes diagnosis flagged for review"; RULE diabetes_flag_dup "Duplicate diabetes flag" WHEN 2300.HI.diagnosis_code = "E11.9" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Diabetes diagnosis flagged for review"; RULE diabetes_reject "Reject diabetes claims outright" WHEN 2300.HI.diagnosis_code = "E11.9" THEN REJECT "Diabetes claims auto-rejected"; RULE hypertension_review "Review hypertension claims" WHEN 2300.HI.diagnosis_code = "I10" THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "Hypertension claim — manual review"; RULE stay_7_14 "Review stays 7–14 days" WHEN 2300.CLM.days_stay BETWEEN 7 AND 14 THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "Medium-length stay review"; RULE stay_7_14_dup "Duplicate: also reviews 7–14 day stays" WHEN 2300.CLM.days_stay BETWEEN 7 AND 14 THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "Medium-length stay review"; RULE stay_10_21 "Flag long stays 10–21 days" WHEN 2300.CLM.days_stay BETWEEN 10 AND 21 THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Extended stay flagged"; RULE stay_1_5 "Review short stays 1–5 days" WHEN 2300.CLM.days_stay BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "Short stay — possible premature discharge"; RULE high_or_er "Flag high amount OR ER visit" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 50000 OR 2400.SV1.place_of_service = "23" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "High amount or ER — flagged"; RULE high_or_er_dup "Duplicate: high amount OR ER" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 50000 OR 2400.SV1.place_of_service = "23" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "High amount or ER — flagged"; RULE high_amount_only "Flag high amount (no OR)" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 50000 THEN FLAG_FRAUD "High amount flagged"; RULE moderate_amount_flag "Flag moderate amounts" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 30000 THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Moderate amount flagged"; RULE not_outpatient_flag "Flag non-outpatient claims" WHEN NOT 2300.CLM.facility_type = "Outpatient" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Non-outpatient claim flagged"; RULE not_outpatient_flag_dup "Duplicate: flag non-outpatient" WHEN NOT 2300.CLM.facility_type = "Outpatient" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "Non-outpatient claim flagged"; RULE not_outpatient_reject "Reject non-outpatient claims" WHEN NOT 2300.CLM.facility_type = "Outpatient" THEN REJECT "Non-outpatient auto-rejected"; RULE cardio_high_amount "Cardiology + high amount" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 50000 AND 2010.NM1.provider_specialty = "cardiology" THEN FLAG_FRAUD "High-amount cardiology claim"; RULE long_stay_high_amount "Long stay + high amount" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 50000 AND 2300.CLM.days_stay > 14 THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "High-amount long-stay claim"; RULE cardio_moderate "Cardiology + moderate amount" WHEN 2300.CLM.claim_amount > 20000 AND 2010.NM1.provider_specialty = "cardiology" THEN REQUIRE_REVIEW "Moderate cardiology claim review";

claims._desc: GROUP E: Diabetes diagnosis — triggers diabetes_flag, dup, reject
GROUP E: Hypertension only — triggers hypertension_review, no diabetes rules
GROUP F: 12-day stay — triggers stay_7_14, dup, stay_10_21 overlap
GROUP F: 3-day stay — triggers stay_1_5 only, disjoint from 7-14
GROUP F: 6-day stay — triggers NO BETWEEN rules (between 5 and 7 gap)
GROUP G: High amount $75k, POS=11 — triggers OR via amount arm
GROUP G: Low amount $500, POS=23 — triggers OR via ER arm only
GROUP G: Both arms — $80k AND POS=23 — OR fires on both disjuncts
GROUP H: Inpatient (NOT Outpatient = TRUE) — triggers negation rules
GROUP H: Outpatient — NOT condition is FALSE, no negation rules fire
GROUP I: Cardiology + $70k + 18-day stay — all three compound rules fire
GROUP I: Orthopedics + $70k + 18-day stay — only long_stay_high_amount fires
CONTROL: Low amount, outpatient, 0-day stay, no special diagnosis — zero rules fire
